quarterly_data.quarter: Shenling Environmental Systems half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 segments (half-year report): data-service segment revenue up 30.68% year on year, industrial down 13.36% (downstream fixed-asset investment slowing) and special-purpose down 57.18%. By product, equipment revenue RMB 1,353,429,019.86 (-2.99%, gross margin 18.63%, down 4.41 points) and solutions and services RMB 392,389,205.52 (+39.81%, gross margin 21.54%, down 8.40 points). Company: H1 market demand kept growing fast, but supply-chain bottlenecks and project implementation progress delayed the conversion into revenue; it is speeding up localized service systems in Southeast Asia and North America
quarterly_data.figure: data-service revenue +30.68% YoY; equipment RMB 1,353,429,019.86 (18.63% GM); solutions and services RMB 392,389,205.52 (21.54% GM)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenling Environmental Systems half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company on the H1 2026 net-profit decline: new orders, output and shipments grew quickly, but (1) delayed project transfer and revenue recognition left revenue growth below expectations, (2) overseas market expansion raised selling expenses (RMB 119,136,220.18, +38.83%), (3) more liquid-cooling and overseas new-product R&D raised R&D investment (RMB 102,775,987.74, +32.42%), and (4) sharper competition in the industrial and special segments lowered gross margin. Goods shipped (an inventory item) were RMB 1,200,536,511.49 at June 30, 2026 versus RMB 408,339,475.85 at the start of the year; the company expects revenue growth and net profit to keep improving in H2 as project transfers accelerate

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenling Environmental Systems half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Construction in progress at June 30, 2026: the liquid-cooling new-quality manufacturing base project has a budget of RMB 800,000,000.00 (raised funds and other sources), with cumulative investment 6.42% of budget and project progress 6.42%; the Gaozhou phase 2 project has a budget of RMB 236,000,000.00, at 26.44%; the new-infrastructure smart temperature-control equipment intelligent manufacturing project (budget RMB 679,895,100.00) is at 99.63%. The company says it is continuing to expand capacity in line with market needs
